name: Fort Ontario Holocaust Refugee Shelter National Historical Park Establishment Act
official: Fort Ontario Holocaust Refugee Shelter National Historical Park Establishment Act

news.title: Fort Ontario National Park Bill Advances

timeline.text: The House received a message from the Clerk. Pursuant to the permission granted in Clause 2(h) of Rule II of the Rules of the U.S. House of Representatives, the Clerk notified the House that he had received the following message from the Secretary of the Senate on November 16, 2026, at 4:44 p.m.: That the Senate passed S. 432, S. 1353, S. 2887, S. 3493, and H.R. 2400 amended.
timeline.label: Passage
timeline.explain: The real vote on the measure itself.

timeline.text: Message on Senate action sent to the House.
timeline.label: Update

timeline.text: Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S5668; text: CR S5669)
timeline.label: Amendment
timeline.explain: A vote on a proposed change, not on the bill itself.

timeline.text: Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources discharged by Unanimous Consent.
timeline.label: Update

timeline.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
timeline.label: Introduced / sent to committee
